scheme_name: National Awards For Outstanding Services In The Field Of Prevention Of Alcoholism And Substance (Drug) Abuse: Best Non-profit Institution With Outstanding Contributions To The Prevention Of Alcoholism And Substance (Drug) Abuse
other_conditions: Open to all Indian institutions, organisations and individuals without discrimination on the basis of religion, race, sex, caste or creed.
Nominee must be recommended in writing by an authorised agency or person; self‑nominations are not accepted.
Any individual or organisation that has received the award is ineligible for the next three award cycles.
For institutions (IRCA) a minimum of five years experience in the field of prevention of alcoholism and substance (drug) abuse is required.

The institution must have demonstrated comprehensive treatment and rehabilitation services, community outreach, documentation, financial credibility and related achievements as detailed in the eligibility criteria.
benefits_summary: Awardees receive a citation, memento and a cash prize of ₹4,00,000, together with travel, lodging and related expenses covered by the Central Government.
